subject: ela
intro: Informative writing teaches the reader something true about a topic. A good informative paragraph has three parts: an introduction sentence that names the topic, fact sentences in the middle that teach the reader, and a concluding statement that wraps up what was shared. Unlike opinion writing, informative writing does not use 'I think' — it sticks to facts and definitions.

items.prompt: Write an informative paragraph about penguins. Include an introduction sentence, two facts, and a concluding sentence.

steps: Step 1: Write an introduction sentence that names the topic: 'Penguins are amazing birds that live in cold climates.'
Step 2: Add a fact sentence: 'Unlike most birds, penguins cannot fly, but they are excellent swimmers.'
Step 3: Add another fact or definition: 'Penguins eat fish, squid, and tiny sea animals called krill.'
Step 4: Write a concluding sentence that wraps up: 'Penguins are fascinating creatures that are perfectly built for life in and around the ocean.'
solution.answer: Penguins are amazing birds that live in cold climates. Unlike most birds, penguins cannot fly, but they are excellent swimmers. Penguins eat fish, squid, and tiny sea animals called krill. Penguins are fascinating creatures that are perfectly built for life in and around the ocean.

items.prompt: Write an informative paragraph about the water cycle. Include an introduction, two or three facts, and a concluding sentence.

steps: Step 1: Introduction sentence: 'The water cycle is the way water moves around Earth over and over again.'
Step 2: Fact 1: 'Water evaporates from oceans and lakes, turning into water vapor that rises into the sky.'
Step 3: Fact 2: 'The water vapor cools and forms clouds, and then falls back to Earth as rain or snow.'
Step 4: Concluding sentence: 'Thanks to the water cycle, Earth always has fresh water for plants, animals, and people.'
solution.answer: The water cycle is the way water moves around Earth over and over again. Water evaporates from oceans and lakes, turning into water vapor that rises into the sky. The water vapor cools and forms clouds, and then falls back to Earth as rain or snow. Thanks to the water cycle, Earth always has fresh water for plants, animals, and people.

items.prompt: A student wrote: 'I love spiders. They have eight legs.' What is wrong with this informative paragraph? Rewrite it correctly.

steps: Problem: 'I love spiders' is an opinion, not a fact. Informative writing should not include personal opinions.
Step 1: Replace the first sentence with a factual introduction: 'Spiders are small animals that belong to a group called arachnids.'
Step 2: Keep the fact about eight legs: 'All spiders have eight legs and two body parts.'
Step 3: Add another fact: 'Most spiders spin silk webs to catch insects for food.'
Step 4: Add a concluding sentence: 'Spiders play an important role in nature by helping to control the insect population.'
solution.answer: Spiders are small animals that belong to a group called arachnids. All spiders have eight legs and two body parts. Most spiders spin silk webs to catch insects for food. Spiders play an important role in nature by helping to control the insect population.

items.prompt: Write a 4-sentence informative paragraph about volcanoes. Include a topic introduction, a definition, a fact, and a concluding sentence.

steps: Step 1: Introduction: 'Volcanoes are mountains that can erupt and shoot hot melted rock into the air.'
Step 2: Definition: 'The melted rock inside a volcano is called magma, but when it flows out, it is called lava.'
Step 3: Fact: 'Some volcanoes erupt often, while others have been quiet for thousands of years.'
Step 4: Concluding sentence: 'Volcanoes are powerful forces of nature that shape the land around them.'
solution.answer: Volcanoes are mountains that can erupt and shoot hot melted rock into the air. The melted rock inside a volcano is called magma, but when it flows out, it is called lava. Some volcanoes erupt often, while others have been quiet for thousands of years. Volcanoes are powerful forces of nature that shape the land around them.

items.prompt: Write a complete informative paragraph (4-5 sentences) about honeybees. Include an introduction, facts, and a concluding statement.

steps: Step 1: Introduction: 'Honeybees are hardworking insects that live in large groups called colonies.'
Step 2: Fact 1: 'Worker bees collect nectar from flowers and bring it back to the hive to make honey.'
Step 3: Fact 2: 'A single hive can hold up to 60,000 bees, including one queen bee who lays all the eggs.'
Step 4: Fact 3: 'Bees help plants grow by carrying pollen from one flower to another in a process called pollination.'
Step 5: Concluding sentence: 'Without honeybees, many of the fruits and vegetables we eat would not be able to grow.'
solution.answer: Honeybees are hardworking insects that live in large groups called colonies. Worker bees collect nectar from flowers and bring it back to the hive to make honey. A single hive can hold up to 60,000 bees, including one queen bee who lays all the eggs. Bees help plants grow by carrying pollen from one flower to another in a process called pollination. Without honeybees, many of the fruits and vegetables we eat would not be able to grow.

items.prompt: Write an informative paragraph (3-4 sentences) about the sun. Include an introduction, at least one fact or definition, and a concluding sentence.
items.hint: Start with 'The sun is...' Include a fact about what the sun does for Earth. End with a wrapping-up sentence.

steps: Introduction: name the topic with a factual sentence.
Fact(s): add one or two true statements about the sun.
Concluding sentence: wrap up with a general statement about the sun's importance.
solution.answer: The sun is a giant star at the center of our solar system. It provides Earth with heat and light that living things need to survive. Without the sun, plants could not grow and temperatures on Earth would be too cold to support life.

items.prompt: Write a 4-sentence informative paragraph about the rainforest. Include an introduction, two facts, and a concluding sentence. Do NOT use 'I think' anywhere.
items.hint: Begin with what a rainforest is. Share two facts about what lives there or what makes it special. Close by explaining why rainforests matter.

steps: Introduction: define or describe a rainforest.
Fact 1: a feature or animal of the rainforest.
Fact 2: another interesting detail.
Concluding sentence: wrap up with its importance.
solution.answer: A rainforest is a thick, warm forest that receives a large amount of rain throughout the year. Rainforests are home to more than half of the world's plant and animal species. They help clean the air by absorbing carbon dioxide and producing oxygen. Rainforests are one of Earth's most important and valuable ecosystems.

items.prompt:
Identify the PROBLEM in this informative paragraph. Then rewrite just the problem sentence.

'Elephants are the largest land animals on Earth. I think elephants are cool. Elephants use their long trunks to drink water and pick up objects.'
items.hint: One sentence does not belong in informative writing. Look for a sentence that expresses a personal feeling.

steps: Problem: 'I think elephants are cool' is an opinion and does not belong in informative writing.
Replace it with a fact: 'Elephants are highly intelligent animals that live in close family groups called herds.'
solution.answer: Problem sentence: 'I think elephants are cool.' Replacement: 'Elephants are highly intelligent animals that live in close family groups called herds.'

items.prompt: Write a complete informative paragraph about frogs. Include an introduction sentence, a definition or key fact, a second fact, and a concluding sentence.
items.hint: A frog is an amphibian — start there. Include one fact about what they eat or how they grow. End with a sentence about why frogs are interesting or important.

steps: Introduction: Frogs are amphibians.
Key fact or definition: describe what amphibian means or what frogs eat.
Second fact: another detail about frogs.
Concluding sentence: wrap up.
solution.answer: Frogs are amphibians, which means they can live both in water and on land. Frogs start their lives as tadpoles in the water and slowly grow legs as they become adults. They eat insects, worms, and small bugs, catching their prey with a long, sticky tongue. Frogs are important animals that help control insect populations in many ecosystems.

items.prompt: Write a 4-sentence informative paragraph about a topic from science or social studies. Choose one: the seasons, community helpers, or planets. Include an introduction, two facts, and a concluding sentence.
items.hint: Pick your topic and start with a sentence that introduces it. Make sure each sentence teaches the reader something true. End with a sentence that sums up why the topic is interesting or important.

steps: Introduction: introduce the topic with a factual sentence.
Fact 1: a specific true detail about the topic.
Fact 2: another specific true detail.
Concluding sentence: wrap up by explaining why this topic matters.
solution.answer: Earth has four seasons: spring, summer, fall, and winter. Each season happens because Earth tilts toward or away from the sun as it travels around it. In summer, the days are long and warm, while in winter, the days are short and cold. The changing seasons affect the weather, animals, and plants in every part of the world.
